description: Gana koota — temperament (Deva/divine, Manushya/human, Rakshasa/demon) compatibility from each partner's janma nakshatra. Scored via a DIRECTIONAL 3x3 matrix (groom's gana vs bride's gana).

scoring.orientation: rows = groom's gana, columns = bride's gana

notes: Same gana on both sides always scores the full 6.

Directional nuance is real and asymmetric: Manushya-groom x Rakshasa-bride = 0 but Rakshasa-groom x Manushya-bride = 3; Deva-groom x Manushya-bride = 6 but Manushya-groom x Deva-bride = 5. This matrix is written groom-row / bride-column; if the product's role mapping (manifest.role_mapping) is confirmed the OTHER way, the matrix must be transposed accordingly.
Deva x Rakshasa is given as 1 here (some tables use 0); review_required.
